Title: Manager, Commercial Performance Analytics.
Description: Work Location Assignment: Mexico City, must be able to work from assigned Pfizer office 2-3 days per week , or as needed by the business. The Manager, Performance Analytics & Insights is a hands-on individual contributor responsible for developing robust analytical solutions, evaluating commercial performance, and generating actionable insights that support business decision-making. This role combines strong technical capabilities, quantitative problem-solving, and business understanding to transform complex data into reliable analytical assets, performance reporting, and meaningful insights. Working closely with U.S.-based Performance Analytics and Insights (PAI) colleagues, the successful candidate will design, develop, and optimize analytical workflows, support recurring reporting, and translate business questions into evidence-based insights. The role contributes to strengthening Pfizer’s internal analytics capabilities through technical ownership, automation, continuous improvement, and collaborative delivery. The position operates within PAI, part of Global Commercial Analytics (GCA), and does not involve people management responsibilities. Role Responsibilities Technical Development & Analytics Solutions Design, develop, and maintain scalable analytics solutions using SQL, Python, R, and related technologies. Build, optimize, and automate datasets, data pipelines, and reporting frameworks to support commercial performance measurement. Engineer and integrate data from multiple internal and external sources to create robust analytical datasets. Develop and maintain high-quality analytical assets, including dashboards, reporting tools, and reusable code libraries. Improve performance, reliability, and scalability of existing analytics workflows through automation and process optimization. Leverage AI, scripting, and emerging analytical technologies to increase efficiency and analytical capabilities. Analysis & Insight Generation Perform advanced analyses on patient, HCP, payer, and commercial datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and risks. Apply statistical, quantitative, and machine learning techniques to solve business problems and generate actionable insights. Conduct data quality assessments, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure accuracy and consistency of analytical outputs. Translate complex analytical findings into clear insights supported by quantitative evidence. Collaboration & Partnership Partner closely with US-based PAI colleagues as the primary point of collaboration, supporting shared analytics priorities and delivering against team-defined requirements. Translate information needs surfaced by PAI leads into robust analytical solutions, connecting datasets to tell a clear, compelling story backed by quantitative evidence. Work with PAI and broader analytic functions to advance the use of novel data sources and improve reporting processes, tools, and standards. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, analytics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, information systems, business, or a related quantitative field. 5+ years of relevant professional experience in analytics, business intelligence, data analysis, or a related technical analytical role. Strong hands-on proficiency in SQL, Python, or R, including the ability to independently develop, troubleshoot, and optimize analytical code for data extraction, transformation, integration, and analysis. Advanced professional English proficiency, both written and verbal, with the ability to independently collaborate with U.S.-based stakeholders, discuss technical concepts, and communicate analytical findings clearly. Demonstrated experience integrating and transforming data from multiple sources to develop accurate, reliable analytical datasets. Ability to understand, modify, and improve existing analytical code, calculations, and reporting workflows. Ability to translate business requirements into structured analytical approaches and independently deliver high-quality analytical solutions. Preferred Qualifications Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or commercial analytics. Understanding of commercial performance metrics, including sales, market access, patient journey, or field force KPIs. Experience supporting U.S. or global commercial organizations, preferably within international or nearshore analytics teams. Experience developing, optimizing, or troubleshooting data pipelines, ETL processes, or automated analytical workflows. Demonstrated contributions to improved analytical efficiency, cost reduction, reporting automation, or faster business decision-making. Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, and Category Management to drive business performance. Strong business acumen and understanding of key commercial metrics such as revenue, profitability, market share, forecast accuracy, and ROI. Experience with syndicated market data tools such as NielsenIQ (NIQ) or Circana. Previous exposure to Joint Business Plans (JBPs), customer business reviews, or commercial planning processes. Experience with data automation and reporting process improvements. Title: AI Data Engineer
Description: AI Data Engineer - Mexico City Position Purpose We are seeking a passionate and motivated AI Data Engineer to join our international team as part of the strategic expansion of our AI and Data capabilities. This role is ideal for someone in the early stages of their data engineering career who has a strong technical foundation and is interested in developing expertise in modern data platforms, automation, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs). Working alongside experienced Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, and Data Architects, you will help build and maintain the data foundations that support analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and intelligent automation across the organization. You will contribute to the development of reliable data pipelines, data transformation processes, and AI-ready datasets while gaining practical experience with modern data architectures, cloud technologies, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, and data governance. This is a hands-on engineering role with significant opportunities to learn, develop new technical capabilities, and progressively take ownership of data and AI engineering solutions. What You Will Be Doing Develop, maintain, and improve data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment pipelines supporting vehicle data and AI initiatives. Lead innitiatives for the modernization and migration of legacy data platforms, applications, and operational processes to modern data environments. Automate manual or repetitive data processes using Python, SQL, and other data engineering technologies. Design and execute migration and validation of data from legacy applications, databases, file systems, and on-premise environments. Develop and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformations, and data models. Build data processing solutions using technologies such as Python, SQL, Spark, and distributed data platforms. Contribute to data solutions supporting LLM applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, vector databases, and knowledge management. Prepare, transform, and validate datasets used for machine learning and AI applications. Work with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to support training datasets, feature engineering, and inference pipelines. Contribute to reusable data products and Data-as-a-Service capabilities. Implement and maintain automated data quality checks and validation processes. Support metadata, data lineage, cataloging, and documentation activities. Help monitor data pipelines and investigate data quality or processing issues. Follow organizational standards for data security, privacy, access management, and governance. Contribute to AI governance activities related to data sourcing, quality, traceability, and responsible use of data. Collaborate with technical and business teams to identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. Participate in agile ceremonies, technical discussions, solution reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives. Continuously develop knowledge of emerging technologies across data engineering, cloud platforms, Generative AI, vector search, and modern AI architectures. What You Need For This Position Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Approximately 3 to 5 years of professional experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Big Data, or a related technical role. Good working knowledge of Python and SQL. Practical experience building or maintaining data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, or data integrations. Practical experience on migrating legacy systems to new platforms. Experience with data processing technologies such as Spark or similar frameworks is desirable. Understanding of databases, data modeling, APIs, and data integration concepts. Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms or modern data architectures such as data lakes and lakehouses is desirable. Strong understanding of software development practices, including Git and version control. Interest in AI and Machine Learning workflows, particularly Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and AI-driven automation. Awareness of data quality, security, privacy, and governance principles. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability and willingness to learn new technologies quickly. Ability to work collaboratively with Data Engineering, Data Science, AI, Product, Architecture, and Business teams. Good communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics clearly. Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to problem solving. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multicultural, and international environment. Curiosity, initiative, and a genuine passion for data, technology, and AI. Nice to Have Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Exposure to Databricks or similar modern data platforms. Understanding of CI/CD concepts and automated deployment processes. Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, or RAG solutions. Exposure to AI coding and development tools. Personal, academic, or professional projects involving Machine Learning or Generative AI. Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage, or data governance tools.

Our goal is to empower all teams at Amazon Music to make data driven decisions and effectively measure their results by providing high quality, high availability data, and democratized data access through self-service tools. If you love the challenges that come with big data then this role is for you. We collect billions of events a day, manage petabyte scale data on Redshift and S3, and develop data pipelines using Spark/Scala EMR, SQL based ETL, Airflow services. We are looking for talented, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented Data Engineer, who knows how to take on big data challenges in an agile way. You'll help build Amazon Music's most important data pipelines and data sets, and expand self-service data knowledge and capabilities through an Amazon Music data university. DISCO team develops data specifically for a set of key business domains like personalization and marketing and provides and protects a robust self-service core data experience for all internal customers. We deal in AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, EMR, EC2, DynamoDB, Kinesis Firehose, and Lambda. You'll build our data university and partner with Product, Marketing, BI, and ML teams to build new behavioural events, pipelines, datasets, models, and reporting to support their initiatives. You'll also continue to develop big data pipelines. Key job responsibilities You will work with Product Managers, Data scientists and other Data Engineers to help design, develop and deliver scalable data analytics platform and data pipeline solutions to support various Science, ML initiatives and at the scale and speed of Amazon Music. In addition, you will help design, develop, and deliver components for the analytics platform at the broader org level and streamline/automate workflows for the broader DISCO organization. A day in the life Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, data scientists, business intelligence engineers, to design and architect a modern data analytics platform on AWS, utilizing the AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK). Develop robust and scalable data pipelines using SQL/PySpark/Airflow to efficiently ingest, process, and transform large volumes of data from various sources into a structured format, ensuring data quality and integrity. Design and implement an efficient and scalable data warehousing solution on AWS, using appropriate NoSQL/SQL storage and database technologies for structured and unstructured data. Automate ETL/ELT processes to streamline data integration from diverse data sources and ensure the platform's reliability and efficiency. Create data models to support business intelligence, providing actionable insights and interactive reports to end-users. Enable advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities within the platform to derive predictive and prescriptive insights from the data through tools like EMR/SageMaker Notebooks Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, databases, and applications, ensuring low-latency data access for analytics and machine learning tasks. Implement robust security measures and ensure data compliance with internal requirements, industry standards, and regulations to safeguard sensitive information. Work closely with data scientists and business intelligence engineers to understand their requirements and collaborate on data-related projects. Create comprehensive technical documentation for the platform's architecture, data models, and APIs to facilitate knowledge sharing and maintainability. About The Team Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Title: Product Engineer
Description: Nuestro cliente ayuda a las empresas en México a cobrar más rápido. Automatiza facturación, recordatorios, pagos y conciliación bancaria en un solo lugar, y usa IA para decidir a quién cobrar, cuándo y cómo dar seguimiento. Hablar con clientes y con Customer Ops para entender qué les duele de verdad. Construir agentes de IA que hacen el trabajo por los clientes: conciliación, facturación, seguimiento y reportes. Lo que buscamos 5+ años construyendo y lanzando software en producción. Dominio de SQL y bases de datos. Experiencia o interés en TypeScript (es un gran plus). React y Node se aprenden. Que entiendas problemas, no solo tickets, y te sientas cómodo hablando con clientes. Criterio de producto: sabes qué construir y cómo debe funcionar. Curiosidad real por la IA: exploras herramientas, flujos y agentes, y los usas en tu trabajo diario. Español nativo e inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación y herramientas. Trabajo directo con los fundadores, en un equipo chico donde tu trabajo se nota. Base en Monterrey o CDMX, con días en oficina.
